attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 15, `ulaF` to `yjfK`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 8% of calls. The model names 93 to 99% of them, fewest at column 15, `yjfK`, 93%.

**A short variable stretch follows**, columns 16 to 17, `yjfJ` and `yjfI`, carried by 87 to 88%. The `ula` genes, columns 0 to 7, are [[ascorbate transport and catabolism]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 79%, and hesitates less there, 0.19 against 0.95 bits. It hesitates most at column 64, `cadA`, a variable column, 1.57 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 62 to 79 are carried by 29 to 64% of chromosomes, 13 persistent and 5 shell. The last column is `adiA`, in 29% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.40 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.03 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 60% against 97%.

label: ulaF
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ulaF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ulaF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,923 to 4,002 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ulaF once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,484 calls, named 97%, 0.13 bits; shell 6,665 calls, named 69%, 1.48 bits; cloud 731 calls, named 17%, 3.90 bits. Outside an RGP 37,075 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,805 calls, named 60%, 2.03 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 2 fork, 20 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.03 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (60% against 97%); 5,805 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 64 (cadA, a variable column) 1.57 bits, RGP 84%; column 65 (dtpC, a variable column) 1.37 bits, RGP 88%; column 66 (lysS, a variable column) 1.23 bits, RGP 86%. The 6 columns (columns 63-68) where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 1.26 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 93%, 0.33 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 58 spine columns: named 97%, 0.19 bits on average; the 22 fork and variable columns: named 79%, 0.95 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 64, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 62-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 31-88%; the least: columns 52-61 (spine), RGP 1-10%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-15 (16 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-8%. Genes: ulaF, ulaE, ulaD, ulaC "PTS ascorbate transporter subunit I…", ulaB, ulaA, ulaG, ulaR, yjfP "esterase", bsmA, yjfN "DUF1471 family protease activator Y…", aidB, yjfC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…", yjfM "DUF1190 domain-containing protein", yjfL "DUF350 domain-containing protein", yjfK "YjfK family protein". named 93-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 15 (yjfK), named 93%; most hesitant at column 14 (yjfL), 0.53 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 16-17 (2 columns) variable: share 87-88%, all S, RGP 11%. named 94-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16, named 94%, 0.30 bits.
[S2.c16]    16: yjfJ S 87% "PspA/IM30 family protein"
[S2.c17]    17: yjfI S 88% "YjfI family protein"
[S3] 3. columns 18-43 (26 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 3-9%. Genes: rlmB, rnr, nsrR, purA, yjeT "DUF2065 domain-containing protein", hflC, hflK "FtsH protease activity modulator Hf…", hflX, hfq, miaA, mutL, amiB, tsaE, nnr, queG, "hypothetical protein", orn, rsgA, asd, mscM, yjeM "glutamate/gamma-aminobutyrate famil…", epmA, frdA "fumarate reductase (quinol) flavopr…", frdB, frdC, frdD. named 74-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 38 (yjeM), named 74%, 0.96 bits.
[S4] 4. column 44 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 3%. named 98%; 0.10 bits.
[S4.c44]    44: ampC P 90%
[S5] 5. columns 45-50 (6 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 3%. Genes: blc, sugE, ecnB "lipoprotein toxin entericidin B", ecnA, efp, epmB. named 97-98% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 45 (blc), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 50 (epmB)).
[S6] 6. column 51 variable: share 89%, all P, RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.38 bits.
[S6.c51]    51: yjeJ P 89% "YjeJ family protein"
[S7] 7. columns 52-61 (10 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 1-10%. Genes: yjeI "DUF4156 domain-containing protein", groL "chaperonin GroEL", groS, yjeH "L-methionine/branched-chain amino a…", fxsA, aspA, dcuA, cutA, dsbD, dicD. named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 61 (dicD), named 95%; most hesitant at column 53 (groL), 0.37 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 62-79 (18 columns) fork and variable columns: share 29-64%, 13 P, 5 S, RGP 31-88%. named 60-86% (mean 75%), fewest named at column 73, named 60%; most hesitant at column 64, 1.57 bits.
[S8.c62]    62 fork: cadC S 62% "lysine decarboxylation/transport tr…"; also "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase" S 16%
[S8.c63-78]    columns 63-78 variable, share 41-64%, 12 P, 4 S: cadB 63%, cadA 63%, dtpC 63%, lysS 63%, ghoT 63%, ghoS "type V toxin-antitoxin system endor…" 63%, yjdJ "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase" 64%, yjdI "4Fe-4S mono-cluster protein YjdI" 64%, dcuS "sensor histidine kinase" 64%, dcuR 64%, dcuB 63%, fumB 62%, yjdF "DUF2238 domain-containing protein" 61%, melB "melibiose:sodium transporter MelB" 42%, melA 57%, melR 41%
[S8.c79]    79 fork: adiA P 29%; also adiY P 14%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 0-7 (ulaF to ulaR) [S1]: ascorbate, phosphate, transporter; columns 23-25 (hflC to hflX) [S3]: modulator, protease; columns 40-43 (frdA to frdD) [S3]: fumarate, reductase; columns 62-64 (cadC to cadA) [S8]: lysine.
[X] PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): ulaF L-ribulose-5-phosphate 4-epimerase UlaF; ulaE L-ribulose-5-phosphate 3-epimerase UlaE; ulaD 3-keto-L-gulonate-6-phosphate decarboxy…; ulaB PTS ascorbate transporter subunit IIB; ulaA PTS ascorbate transporter subunit IIC; ulaG L-ascorbate 6-phosphate lactonase; ulaR HTH-type transcriptional regulator UlaR; hflC protease modulator HflC; hflX ribosome rescue GTPase HflX; frdB fumarate reductase iron-sulfur protein; frdC fumarate reductase subunit FrdC; frdD fumarate reductase subunit FrdD; ecnA lipoprotein antitoxin entericidin A; groS co-chaperone GroES; cadC lysine decarboxylation/transport transc…; cadB cadaverine/lysine antiporter; cadA lysine decarboxylase CadA; ghoT type V toxin-antitoxin system toxin GhoT; dcuR two-component system response regulator…; dcuB anaerobic C4-dicarboxylate transporter…; melA alpha-galactosidase; adiY DNA-binding transcriptional activator A…
[E] END: the window ends at column 79, adiA, in 29% of chromosomes.
